title: StarkweatherOFC-CCEP: orbitofrontal cortico-cortical evoked potential recordings, 7 patients (Starkweather et al.) (derivative)
description: Intracranial recordings of cortico-cortical evoked potentials (CCEPs) elicited by single-pulse electrical stimulation in the orbitofrontal cortex of seven patients, accompanying the manuscript "Rapid Homotopic Communication Between Human Orbitofrontal Subregions" (Starkweather et al.). The dataset is a derivative repackaging of the authors' preprocessed per-electrode timeseries, both unreferenced and bipolar, together with stimulation event times and amplitudes. It supports study of effective connectivity and rapid homotopic communication between orbitofrontal subregions.
methods_description: Authors' preprocessed per-electrode orbitofrontal timeseries at 1000 Hz (unreferenced and bipolar re-referenced) were converted to BrainVision float32 in microvolts. Single-pulse stimulation times and amplitudes were written to events.tsv. Electrode localisation is given as sulcus-relative distances rather than x/y/z coordinates.
